title: Fix release-plz workflow (403 opening PR) for GitFlow releases from main

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Diagnosis (attempt A): every Release workflow run since repo creation fails with release-plz 'Failed to open PR' — HTTP 403 Forbidden on POST /repos/example-org/example-repo/pulls. Root cause: repo setting 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' is disabled (can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false), so GITHUB_TOKEN cannot open PRs even though the workflow declares pull-requests: write. Side effect: 46 stale release-plz-* branches pushed to remote (one per failed run) with no PR attached. Fix: enable the repo setting; workflow also gets workflow_dispatch trigger and optional RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN secret fallback. Board changes committed straight to develop per instructions.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Outcome (attempt A): fix landed. Commits: 3529298 (kanbus board, straight to develop) and c221611 ci(release): make release-plz work under GitFlow (PR #2, fast-forwarded into develop). Change: release.yml keeps main-only push trigger per GitFlow, adds workflow_dispatch for manual runs, and resolves GITHUB_TOKEN from optional RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN secret so a PAT can bypass the PR-creation restriction (falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN when unset). Root cause remains a repo setting only the maintainer can set: 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' is disabled (can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false), causing GITHUB_TOKEN 403 on POST /pulls on every Release run; 46 stale release-plz-* branches piled up as a side effect (not deleted, listed in report). Gates: fmt, clippy -D warnings, full test suite, actionlint 1.7.12 all green locally; PR #2 CI 8/8 green; develop CI run 37068669523 all 8 jobs green. Closing.
